sources.title: IBM-ESA TerraMind
sources.snippet: Meet TerraMind, the first any-to-any generative, multimodal foundation model for Earth observation. TerraMind represents new levels of understanding geospatial data, introduces new capabilities such as Thinking-in-Modalities (TiM), and outperforms existing models significantly across community-standard benchmarks.

sources.title: TerraMind: Large-Scale Generative Multimodality for Earth Observation
sources.snippet: Figure 1: TerraMind represents the first any-to-any generative, and large-scale multimodal model for Earth observation pre-trained on 1 trillion tokens from global geospatial data. The model digests dual-scale representations at pixel-level and token-level simultaneously. sources.title: Terramind — The shared brain for your company
sources.snippet: Every frontier model. Deep research, multi-step tasks — one window. AI-native code editor with auto-review, cloud agents, and event-driven automations. Image, video, music, voice, and 3D — generated in the same session as your code.
